changelog:
Initial release of CashClaw SEO Auditor.

- Performs comprehensive, tiered SEO audits (Basic, Standard, Pro) with specific price and scope.
- Covers technical SEO, on-page optimization, off-page signals, and performance metrics.
- Provides actionable, data-driven recommendations linked to actual findings.
- Generates deliverable Markdown reports with prioritized action plans and score breakdowns.
- Includes clear scoring, grading, and packaging standards for client-ready output.
